data.name: Misael
data.gender_notes: Misael is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Misael means 'Who is God?'. This name is derived from the Hebrew words 'mis' (who) and 'el' (God). In the Bible, Misael is one of the three Hebrew men who, along with Shadrach and Meshach, refused to bow down to King Nebuchadnezzar's golden image. They were then cast into a fiery furnace, but God protected them, and they emerged unharmed.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those seeking to deepen their faith and relationship with God.
data.etymology: Misael belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Who is God?.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Misael total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: מישאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מישאל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'מי הוא אלוהים' או 'השואל אלוהים'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'מי' שפירושו 'מי' ו-'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם מישאל מופיע בתנ'ך כבן של משה ואשתו צפורה, וגם כדמות אחרת בתנ'ך.

in_greek.name: Μισαήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: ὁ Μισαήλ ἐστιν ὄνομα ἑβραϊκόν, τὸ ὁποῖον σημαίνει 'τίς ἐστιν θεός;' ἤ 'ἐρωτών θεός'. Ἐκ τῶν δύο λέξεων συντίθεται: 'τίς' τὸ ὅστις καὶ 'ἐλ' τὸ θεός. Ὁ Μισαήλ ἐμφανίζεται εἰς τὴν Παλαιὰν Διαθήκην ὡς υἱὸς Μωυσέως καὶ τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ Σεφώρας.

in_latin.name: Misael
in_latin.long_meaning: Misael nomen hebraicum est, quod significat 'quis est Deus' vel 'interrogans Deum'. Componitur ex duobus verbis: 'quis' quod est 'quis' et 'el' quod est 'Deus'. Misael in Biblia apparet ut filius Moysis et uxoris eius Sephorae.

in_english.name: Misael

In the Bible, Misael appears as the son of Moses and his wife Zipporah. The name Misael has been used in Christian tradition to signify a person who seeks God's guidance and wisdom.
